english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for reacting wildly or irrationally under stress.
Use this when someone goes berserk or becomes extremely angry, rather than simply turning something over.

examples.english: I freak out whenever I hear that the report has gone wrong.
examples.traditional: 我一聽到份報告出錯就發癲喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teng1 dou3 fan6 bou3 gou3 ceot1 co3 zau6 faat3 din1 laa3

examples.english: They flip out as soon as they hear the rent is going up.
examples.traditional: 佢一聽到要加租就發癲。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 jiu3 gaa1 zou1 zau6 faat3 din1
